Subject: Deep-dive: technical next steps & calendar lock

Alex —

Great to meet this morning — thanks for the candid discussion about your inference workload and the latency targets you need for the analytics pipeline. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary goals: sub-150ms p95 for short queries, and cost target under $0.003/token for batch scoring.
- Constraints: on-prem data residency for PII, and current traffic burstiness around month-end.
- Next step: technical deep-dive with infra + model ops to validate KV-cache behavior and batching strategy.

To keep momentum, can we lock a 60-minute deep-dive next week? Two options (all PT):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 PT

If neither works reply with 1–2 slots that do and I’ll lock the calendar. If possible, include your infra lead or procurement (I notice procurement@acmeanalytics.com on the initial invite) — we’ll keep the agenda tightly focused: architecture review, SLOs, and rollout path.

I’ve cc’d Rishi and Monica so they can prep relevant artifacts (quantization plan, SLA notes).

Thanks,
Ben

Ben —

Sorry about the radio silence — I was pulled into an exec planning session and missed the recap you mentioned (and a prior stand). My fault. We definitely want to do the deep-dive, but we need tighter confirmation on timing — our infra lead has a jammed calendar and we can only guarantee attendance if a slot is locked within 24 hours.

For context, the week is weird for us: Nov 3 is actually tricky in the morning; Nov 4 looks best after 1pm PT but our preferred windows are:
- Wed Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu Nov 5, 09:00–10:00 PT (fallback)

Can you lock the preferred slot now and send an invite? Also include a short one‑page summary of the deployment model we discussed so I can forward to procurement. Procurement will want the high-level network and data controls before attending.

—Alex

Alex — thanks for the heads-up. Locking Wed Nov 4, 14:00–15:00 PT now. Invite sent (calendar link in the invite).

Attached a one-pager "MAPS-deployment.pdf" that summarizes the private deployment topology, KMS options, and audit log retention — should cover the procurement asks at a glance. Rishi and Monica will be on the call to walk through KV-cache and batching tradeoffs.

If for any reason that slot becomes untenable, please flag before EOD tomorrow and we’ll move to Thu Nov 5, 09:00–10:00 PT. Otherwise we’ll proceed with Wed and I’ll share a 20-minute agenda shortly.

Quick logistics: I added procurement@acmeanalytics.com to the calendar invite as optional — if procurement wants to join live we’ll keep the first 10 minutes as a security/compliance summary.

Attachments: MAPS-deployment.pdf (22KB)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2026-045

Thanks,
Ben
